description: Posting metadata for teaser carousels (sounds + hashtags). Hashtag sets rotate A/B/C per post like hermes HASHTAG_SETS; the winning set gets promoted via learnings. Sounds cannot be attached through the Publer API for photo posts, so the publisher adds one in-app at publish time following soundStrategy.
hashtagNotes: 5 tags max per post: platform best practice for 2026 on both TikTok and IG; more dilutes relevance signals.
#smartorfart is the brand tag and appears in every set so we accrue a branded feed.
Each set mixes 2 broad reach tags with 2 niche puzzle-community tags.

soundStrategy.howTo: Publer photo drafts cannot carry a native sound. When publishing: TikTok -> edit draft -> add sound; IG -> convert to Reel-backed carousel or add audio in composer.
rules: Pick from TikTok Creative Center 'Trending' (Commercial Music Library ONLY - brand account must use commercially-licensed sounds).
Kid-safe brand: no explicit lyrics, nothing CARU-risky (see compliance.md).
Prefer instrumental or low-vocal tracks so text slides stay readable; sound is for distribution, not content.
Refresh picks weekly; trending sounds decay in days. The names below are the 2026-07-22 snapshot, not evergreen.

snapshot.name: Jeopardy theme (timer version, or trending piano/looped covers)
snapshot.why: THE quiz-native sound: universally read as 'you're on the clock', trending in 2026 in remix/cover forms; the timer version turns each puzzle slide into a countdown

snapshot.name: i just get so nervy (super slowed) - HYFY
snapshot.why: trending specifically on quiz/reveal-style carousels; beat syncs with slide swipes

snapshot.name: Big Boom In The Room - Abraao de Santana
snapshot.why: trending for big-reveal content; the build-then-boom fits swipe-to-answer

snapshot.name: How You Like Me Now - The Heavy
snapshot.why: 'told you so' victory energy = smart fella flex after solving

snapshot.name: Moment Of Reflection - Jhonatan, Piano Sky, Dee Piano
snapshot.why: instrumental piano thinking-music; never fights slide text; safe evergreen fallback

soundStrategy.avoid: Drake - Janice STFU, Don Toliver - E85, 'original sound by dusty' (explicit); breakup/divorce narrative tracks (Choosin' Texas, The Cure, Horses & Divorces) - wrong tone; generic summer/travel/fashion trending sounds (Midnight Sun, SS26, Dai Dai etc.) - trending but zero puzzle relevance
